node.label: Increased endomysial connective tissue
node.definition: An increased volume of the endomysium, which is a connective tissue sheath that surrounds each muscle fiber. Together, bundles of muscle fibers form a fasciculus, surrounded by another layer of connective tissue called the perimysium.
